data.name: Rukaiya
data.gender_notes: Rukaiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rukaiya means 'Exalted' or 'Lofty' in Arabic, derived from the root r-k-y which signifies elevation and high status. The name Rukaiya carries the meaning “Exalted, Lofty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rukaiya usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, lofty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rukaiya is associated with dignity, respect, and nobility, embodying the virtues of a spiritually enlightened individual.
data.etymology: Rukaiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Lofty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukaiya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hindi.name: रुकैया
